script.code:
SELECT CAST(j.id AS CHAR) AS id,
       j.job_status,
       j.progress_message,
       j.progress_percent,
       j.error_code,
       j.error_message,
       JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(j.request_payload, '$.operation')) AS operation,
       -- only an open force complete has edits to kick; they are read through the open-job states (an index on job_status)
       CASE WHEN JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(j.request_payload, '$.operation')) = 'FORCE_COMPLETE'
             AND j.job_status IN ('QUEUED', 'VALIDATING', 'READY_TO_COMMIT', 'COMMITTING_PICKING')
            THEN (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(CAST(e.id AS CHAR) ORDER BY e.id)
                    FROM gd_async_job e
                   WHERE e.tenant_id = j.tenant_id
                     AND e.job_status IN ('QUEUED', 'VALIDATING', 'READY_TO_COMMIT', 'COMMITTING_GD', 'HELD')
                     AND (e.job_status <> 'HELD' OR e.next_attempt_at <= NOW(3))
                     AND (e.lease_expires_at IS NULL OR e.lease_expires_at <= NOW(3))
                     AND e.is_deleted = 0 AND e.command = 'EDIT_GD' AND e.causation_id = 'PICKING_FC'
                     AND CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(e.request_payload, '$.causation_job_id')) AS UNSIGNED) = j.id)
       END AS kick
  FROM gd_async_job j
 WHERE j.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_PSguard.data.tenantId}}'
   AND j.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_PSguard.data.organizationId}}'
   AND j.command = 'CONFIRM_PICKING'
   AND j.picking_id = '{{node:code_node_PSguard.data.pickingId}}'
   AND j.is_deleted = 0
 ORDER BY j.id DESC
 LIMIT 1

script.code:
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(NOW(3), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS db_now,
       CAST(t.id AS CHAR) AS id,
       t.to_id,
       t.to_status,
       t.is_deleted,
       t.organization_id,
       CAST(t.plant_id AS CHAR) AS plant_id,
       COALESCE(t.is_processing, 0) AS is_processing,
       COALESCE(t.is_loading_bay, 0) AS is_loading_bay,
       TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, t.update_time, CONVERT_TZ(UTC_TIMESTAMP(), '+00:00', '+08:00')) AS lock_age_sec,
       ps.picking_after,
       CAST(ps.allow_full_picking AS CHAR) AS allow_full_picking,
       CAST(ps.auto_completed_gd AS CHAR) AS auto_completed_gd,
       CAST(ps.is_loading_bay AS CHAR) AS setup_loading_bay,
       (SELECT CONCAT(CAST(j.id AS CHAR), '|', j.job_status)
          FROM gd_async_job j
         WHERE j.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_PSguard.data.tenantId}}'
           AND j.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_PSguard.data.organizationId}}'
           AND j.idempotency_key = '{{node:code_node_PSguard.data.idempotencyKey}}'
         LIMIT 1) AS key_job,
       (SELECT CONCAT(CAST(j.id AS CHAR), '|', j.job_status)
          FROM gd_async_job j
         WHERE j.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_PSguard.data.tenantId}}'
           AND j.command = 'CONFIRM_PICKING'
           AND j.picking_id = '{{node:code_node_PSguard.data.pickingId}}'
           AND j.is_deleted = 0
           AND j.job_status IN ('QUEUED', 'VALIDATING', 'READY_TO_COMMIT', 'COMMITTING_PICKING', 'REQUIRES_REVIEW')
         ORDER BY j.id DESC
         LIMIT 1) AS open_job,
       (SELECT COUNT(*)
          FROM transfer_order_jz8m9w3h_sub l
         WHERE l.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_PSguard.data.tenantId}}'
           AND l.transfer_order_id = {{node:code_node_PSguard.data.pickingId}}
           AND l.is_deleted = 0
           AND COALESCE(l.line_status, '') <> 'Cancelled'
           AND l.pending_process_qty > 0
           AND ((l.target_location IS NOT NULL AND l.target_location <> COALESCE(l.source_bin, 0))
             OR (l.target_batch IS NOT NULL AND l.target_batch <> COALESCE(l.batch_no, 0)))) AS moved_rows,
       (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(g.delivery_no, ''), CAST(g.id AS CHAR))
          FROM JSON_TABLE(IF(JSON_VALID(t.gd_no), t.gd_no, '[]'), '$[*]' COLUMNS (gid VARCHAR(32) PATH '$')) jt
          JOIN goods_delivery g
            ON g.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_PSguard.data.tenantId}}'
           AND g.id = CAST(jt.gid AS UNSIGNED)
         WHERE g.is_deleted = 0
           AND (g.gd_status = 'Processing'
                OR EXISTS (SELECT 1
                             FROM gd_async_job j
                            WHERE j.tenant_id = g.tenant_id
                              AND j.is_deleted = 0
                              AND j.command IN ('EDIT_GD', 'COMPLETE_GD', 'COMPLETE_PACKING')
                              AND j.correlation_id = CONCAT('GD|', g.id) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci
                              AND j.job_status NOT IN ('COMPLETED', 'FAILED', 'CANCELLED')))
         LIMIT 1) AS gd_busy
  FROM (SELECT 1 AS one) o
  LEFT JOIN transfer_order t
    ON t.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_PSguard.data.tenantId}}'
   AND t.id = {{node:code_node_PSguard.data.pickingId}}
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT p.picking_after, p.allow_full_picking, p.auto_completed_gd, p.is_loading_bay
               FROM picking_setup p
              WHERE p.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_PSguard.data.tenantId}}'
                AND p.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_PSguard.data.organizationId}}'
                AND p.is_deleted = 0
              ORDER BY p.id
              LIMIT 1) ps
    ON 1 = 1

script.code:
SELECT CAST('R' AS CHAR) AS kind,
       CAST(x.id AS CHAR) AS row_id,
       CAST(x.gd_id AS CHAR) AS gd_id,
       CAST(x.moved AS CHAR) AS moved,
       CAST(x.bay_bad AS CHAR) AS bay_bad,
       CAST(x.handling_unit_id AS CHAR) AS hu,
       CAST(x.label AS CHAR) AS label,
       CAST(NULL AS CHAR) AS delivery_no,
       CAST(NULL AS CHAR) AS line_count,
       CAST(NULL AS CHAR) AS serial_items,
       CAST(NULL AS CHAR) AS select_picking,
       CAST(NULL AS CHAR) AS linked,
       CAST(NULL AS CHAR) AS other_job
  FROM (SELECT e.*,
       (e.src > 0 AND e.loc > 0 AND e.loc <> e.src) OR (e.bat0 > 0 AND e.bat > 0 AND e.bat <> e.bat0) AS moved,
       (e.loc IS NULL OR e.loc = 0 OR e.loc = e.src) AS bay_bad
  FROM (SELECT l.id, l.gd_id, l.handling_unit_id,
               COALESCE(NULLIF(l.item_name, ''), CAST(l.item_code AS CHAR)) AS label,
               COALESCE(l.source_bin, 0) AS src,
               COALESCE(l.batch_no, 0) AS bat0,
               COALESCE(CASE WHEN p.r IS NOT NULL AND p.pl IS NOT NULL THEN NULLIF(p.pl, 0) ELSE NULLIF(l.target_location, 0) END, l.source_bin) AS loc,
               COALESCE(CASE WHEN p.r IS NOT NULL AND p.pb IS NOT NULL THEN NULLIF(p.pb, 0) ELSE NULLIF(l.target_batch, 0) END, l.batch_no) AS bat
          FROM transfer_order_jz8m9w3h_sub l
          LEFT JOIN JSON_TABLE('{{node:code_node_PSguard.data.moveRowsJson}}', '$[*]' COLUMNS (r BIGINT PATH '$.r', pl BIGINT PATH '$.l', pb BIGINT PATH '$.b')) p
            ON p.r = l.id
         WHERE l.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_PSguard.data.tenantId}}'
           AND l.transfer_order_id = {{node:code_node_PSguard.data.pickingId}}
           AND l.is_deleted = 0
           AND COALESCE(l.line_status, '') <> 'Cancelled'
           AND (('{{node:code_node_PSguard.data.operation}}' = 'PICK_ALL_REMAINING' AND l.pending_process_qty > 0) OR p.r IS NOT NULL)) e) x
 WHERE x.moved = 1
    OR (x.bay_bad = 1
        AND (SELECT COALESCE(ps.is_loading_bay, 0) FROM picking_setup ps
              WHERE ps.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_PSguard.data.tenantId}}' AND ps.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_PSguard.data.organizationId}}'
                AND ps.is_deleted = 0
              ORDER BY ps.id LIMIT 1) = 1)
UNION ALL
SELECT CAST('G' AS CHAR),
       CAST(NULL AS CHAR),
       CAST(g.id AS CHAR),
       CAST(NULL AS CHAR),
       CAST(NULL AS CHAR),
       CAST(NULL AS CHAR),
       CAST(NULL AS CHAR),
       CAST(g.delivery_no AS CHAR),
       CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM goods_delivery_fwii8mvb_sub gl
              WHERE gl.tenant_id = g.tenant_id AND gl.goods_delivery_id = g.id AND gl.is_deleted = 0) AS CHAR),
       CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM goods_delivery_fwii8mvb_sub gl JOIN item i ON i.id = gl.material_id
              WHERE gl.tenant_id = g.tenant_id AND gl.goods_delivery_id = g.id AND gl.is_deleted = 0 AND i.serial_number_management = 1) AS CHAR),
       CAST(COALESCE(g.is_select_picking, 0) AS CHAR),
       CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM document_linkage d
              WHERE d.tenant_id = g.tenant_id AND d.is_deleted = 0 AND d.target_doc_type = 'Sales Order' AND d.link_status = 'Linked'
                AND (d.target_doc_id IN (SELECT gl.line_so_id FROM goods_delivery_fwii8mvb_sub gl
                                          WHERE gl.tenant_id = g.tenant_id AND gl.goods_delivery_id = g.id AND gl.is_deleted = 0 AND gl.line_so_id IS NOT NULL)
                     OR d.target_doc_id IN (SELECT CAST(js.s AS CHAR) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci
                                              FROM JSON_TABLE(IF(JSON_VALID(g.so_id), g.so_id, '[]'), '$[*]' COLUMNS (s BIGINT PATH '$')) js))) AS CHAR),
       CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM gd_async_job j
               JOIN transfer_order t2 ON t2.tenant_id = j.tenant_id AND t2.id = CAST(j.picking_id AS UNSIGNED)
               JOIN JSON_TABLE(IF(JSON_VALID(t2.gd_no), t2.gd_no, '[]'), '$[*]' COLUMNS (gid VARCHAR(32) PATH '$')) jt ON CAST(jt.gid AS UNSIGNED) = g.id
              WHERE j.tenant_id = g.tenant_id AND j.command = 'CONFIRM_PICKING' AND j.is_deleted = 0
                AND j.job_status IN ('QUEUED', 'VALIDATING', 'READY_TO_COMMIT', 'COMMITTING_PICKING', 'REQUIRES_REVIEW')
                AND j.picking_id <> '{{node:code_node_PSguard.data.pickingId}}') AS CHAR)
  FROM goods_delivery g
 WHERE g.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_PSguard.data.tenantId}}'
   AND g.id IN (SELECT y.gd_id FROM (SELECT e.*,
       (e.src > 0 AND e.loc > 0 AND e.loc <> e.src) OR (e.bat0 > 0 AND e.bat > 0 AND e.bat <> e.bat0) AS moved,
       (e.loc IS NULL OR e.loc = 0 OR e.loc = e.src) AS bay_bad
  FROM (SELECT l.id, l.gd_id, l.handling_unit_id,
               COALESCE(NULLIF(l.item_name, ''), CAST(l.item_code AS CHAR)) AS label,
               COALESCE(l.source_bin, 0) AS src,
               COALESCE(l.batch_no, 0) AS bat0,
               COALESCE(CASE WHEN p.r IS NOT NULL AND p.pl IS NOT NULL THEN NULLIF(p.pl, 0) ELSE NULLIF(l.target_location, 0) END, l.source_bin) AS loc,
               COALESCE(CASE WHEN p.r IS NOT NULL AND p.pb IS NOT NULL THEN NULLIF(p.pb, 0) ELSE NULLIF(l.target_batch, 0) END, l.batch_no) AS bat
          FROM transfer_order_jz8m9w3h_sub l
          LEFT JOIN JSON_TABLE('{{node:code_node_PSguard.data.moveRowsJson}}', '$[*]' COLUMNS (r BIGINT PATH '$.r', pl BIGINT PATH '$.l', pb BIGINT PATH '$.b')) p
            ON p.r = l.id
         WHERE l.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_PSguard.data.tenantId}}'
           AND l.transfer_order_id = {{node:code_node_PSguard.data.pickingId}}
           AND l.is_deleted = 0
           AND COALESCE(l.line_status, '') <> 'Cancelled'
           AND (('{{node:code_node_PSguard.data.operation}}' = 'PICK_ALL_REMAINING' AND l.pending_process_qty > 0) OR p.r IS NOT NULL)) e) y WHERE y.moved = 1)

       CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM gd_async_job j
               JOIN transfer_order t2 ON t2.tenant_id = j.tenant_id AND t2.id = CAST(j.picking_id AS UNSIGNED)
               JOIN JSON_TABLE(IF(JSON_VALID(t2.gd_no), t2.gd_no, '[]'), '$[*]' COLUMNS (gid VARCHAR(32) PATH '$')) jt ON CAST(jt.gid AS UNSIGNED) = g.id
